visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Accessor Properties Instead of get and set Methods
visualizerParams.problemDescription: getFahrenheit and setFahrenheit are ordinary methods that callers must remember to call. Turn them into a getter and a setter. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With accessors the derived value reads like a normal property (t.fahrenheit), and the way it is computed can change later without changing any caller.
